company_info.company_description: "We believe reputation is everything! We provide all of our customers with the guarantee, satisfaction and peace of mind that our work will be carried out safety with ultimate respect for your home or office.We are confident when we say that you don’t have to worry about a thing when it comes to Circuit Alert Electrical & Solar.Here are some of the reasons to use Circuit Alert Electrical & Solar:We only use quality equipment and authenticated tier one panels.We have our own teams of installers.Good selection of inverters with a minimum of 10 years warranty.We are trusted SMA approved installers giving our clients a complimentary 5+5 year warrantyWe are Sonnen Battery approved Partners"

reviews.review_description: From the moment we walked into the office we knew that we would be purchasing our Solar system through Circuit Alert. Martin ensured we were comfortable with the product choices and he talked to us, not at us as some do. Truly putting us at ease.It was never about our budget, it was abaout what we wanted to achieve by having solar, and how we could protect ourselves from loss of power. Circuit Alert had the options, they had the products, and with that, we could make an educated decision.Installation was truly quick and easy, and you would not have known they had come and gone. One moment we were on Mains power, the next we were on Solar. Even the conversion of the meter was taken care of Circuit Alert, and they ensured they were with you the entire step of the way. Great people, great customer service.

Very happy with the whole process, from going out of their way to discuss options and quotes, through to final installation and follow up. Being for a rental property, the process was a little different to the norm, but Circuit Alert navigated everything for me, with no issues.The price of the whole system was exceptional as well!

From start to finish, my experience with Circuit Alert was nothing short of excellent. I am extremely happy with the choice we made. The entire team made everything incredibly easy, straightforward and seamless.Right from the first contact, the communication was clear, transparent, and professional. The team took the time to explain everything in detail—from the system that would best suit my requirements to handling all of the admin requirements with our energy supplier. They were always quick to respond to any questions and kept me updated throughout the entire process, making sure I felt informed every step of the way.The installation was smooth, efficient, and well-executed. The technicians were punctual, friendly, and clearly knowledgeable. They completed the entire installation within the timeframe promised, with no delays or issues. The system works flawlessly, and the setup looks neat and professional and makes best use of the space available.Value for money was also a key consideration. I received several quotes from other companies, but Circuit Alert offered the most competitive price without compromising on quality. They also provided excellent after-installation support, which really showed their commitment to customer satisfaction.The entire process was stress-free and has fully delivered all the benefits we were expecting. I highly recommend them to anyone considering solar PV or battery storage solution and would not hesitate to work with Circuit Alert again in the future.

The circuit alert team have installed our solar panels, then more recently (with the subsidy) a battery. Mark and Lisa were always helpful in answering questions (before and after the job) and preparing multiple quotes while we decided on battery size. Installers were polite and gave plenty of information. Panels and battery have worked fine to date (touch wood). Very happy to recommend them.

The whole experience from the initial quote to commissioning of the system has been hassle free and throughly enjoyable. This is solely due to the totally professional manner of everyone we came in contact with. The level of communication and flow of information has been wonderful.Lisa and Martin were our first points of contact and were able to design and supply a system which best suited our needs while staying within our budget.The installation team of Lee and Justin were incredible with a high attention to detail and no shortcuts being taken anywhere. As you can see in the final system install photo a totally neat and clean arrangement, with the many wires and cables out of site within the conduit. The installation team were highly adaptable to address a number of challenges presented to them during the fit out.Additionally the installation team took their time to explain the new wiring and additional switch board configuration due to the three phase system, the shutdown procedure (if required) and the all important system registration and the setup of the system wifi monitoring using the dedicated app.

I went to Lisa and Martin with an idea for power independence. Circuit Alert were fantastic. The system I hoped for works exactly as I'd hoped and I'm already looking to expand on the original installation. Thanks Circuit Alert. Martin and Lisa were able to explain clearly what options were available and what the thought would be the most suitable and value for money.The site was challenging with connection between building required. The installation and grid connection went ahead without a hitch. If I had any questions or had to pass on information Martin and Lisa were only a txt/email/phone call/Whatsapp away.Great service.

I'm glad that I have chosen this company - Circuit Alert Electrical and Solar: very quick and reliable service overall.And the installation and set up went very smooth, very happy with the Circuit Alert Electrical and Solar!.
Value for money and service were on point. Great product and very happy :)
Lisa and the team were incredibly knowledgeable, friendly and always available to answer our questions. The solar install was quick and tidy. Would absolutely recommend these guys.

From start to finish we felt looked after. I contacted Circuit Alert months before going ahead with a quote and Lisa gave me lots to think about but with no hard sell. Circuit Alert had been recommended to me by my niece who had already used the company twice already for installing her solar. We went with their cheapest option which I was a little sceptical as to how good a cheaper system would be. Circuit Alert assured me that they have installed plenty of the cheaper systems and that they all come with very similar warranties. We have not looked back. The installers arrived on time , kept us well informed .Walked us through the set up. The Solax system has not missed a beat. Lisa drops us a line now and then to check everything is as we would expect it to be.

Painless experience from my first contact with the company to the final installation.  The installers were punctual, efficient and left the area spotless.  Loved that they setup the app on my phone as this would have been a challenge for me.

Fair to say, sales and quoting was a good experience and the salesperson Chris was excellentInstallation went generally well, but some traffic damage to roof and damage to skylight dome. I am required to arrange the repair/replacement of the dome and present an invoice for reimbursementThe next steps toward grid connection was a matter of tracking down the info myself, somewhat of minefield for the those not skilled in this path. Still no clarity.

From the first phone call when speaking to Lisa, through the quoting process and then on to the installation it was a well oiled machine. They turned up when they said, did what they said and the system acheived what they said!  I'm so relieved to no great service still exists!

We are very happy to have chosen Circuit Alert to do our solar install, from the initial contact with Lisa they were no pressure to “do it now” like other company and unlike other they came to our home to look and sit down and explain the whole process , all this without any commitment fromus at this stage. Once we gave them the “go ahead” it was a very smooth operation, the young men who came to do the install where great, friendly, polite and very efficient . Our system works as intended and so far no issue. Would recommend the team at Circuit Alert to anyone

Another awesome job from Richard, Lisa and team.Very easy to deal with & once we accepted the quote it didn't take long to have our solar up and running.Evan over Christmas holiday period Lisa was able to help us troubleshoot an issue with our hot water unit which was not related to the solar.CheersJon & Nikki

Douglas and his team have been very patient in answering all my questions, and really came up with the best design for my roof. Our roof is south facing, with significant shading, and they came up with realistic estimates of the production, and  just the right amount of panels to provide maximum production while minimizing shading issues.Installation went smoothly. The installer was also the system designer and he was very nice and competent.I am very likely going back to them for my upcoming battery install!

Really happy to deal with a family operated business. Communication was always prompt and answered all my silly questions. The install team arrived on time, worked hard all day and cleaned up before they left.The office has been great with following up to make sure everything is going well and we are happy.
Excellent communication from Circuit Alert throughout the process.  Quick and efficient installation.  The team were friendly and skilled.

Couldn't be happier with the team at Circuit Alert Solar. The were very easy to deal with and professional, and did all they could to reschedule the installation when impacted by wet weather. Communication was also very good and timely.

Highly recommend Circuit Alert for Solar installations and electrical work. Very punctual and knowledgeable and most importantly very price competitive.The boys were very tidy and did a great job with the install.After service was great and they are more than happy to help out with any questions you may have. 5 stars.
Insightful and informative quoting process. Great install. Very helpful office staff.

These guys were brilliant… Lisa in the office took time to explain things, nothing was an effort to her. Cameron sent detailed quotes for different systems and was happy to explain pros and cons of the types and sizes of the systems available. Steve and Lachie were absolutely fantastic with the install… extremely nice guys, neat, tidy and knew their stuff! The whole process was seamless and I would highly recommend this team if you are wanting hassle free Solar installation with the peace of mind that they are there to support you if any questions or problems arise in the future. I am an extremely happy customer!

Appreciated the on-site visit and personal contact to understand our requirements, explain the panel and inverter options, identify the install location and explain the installation process.The install was completed on the agreed day by an experienced crew - the old system was removed cleanly. The monitoring system and the app were installed and commissioned before leaving site and all arrangements with the supplier managed by the supplier. The only minor issue was that some of the installation waste (cable ties, packers etc) didn't get removed.And the system started generating as soon as it was switched on!

Sales & quoting was much more involved than I was expecting. Everyone provided me with multiple options and layouts which was great.Installation was efficient. It had to be over 2 days as the wind picked up but a mutually agreeable time was chosen later in the week. The installers were very polite, tidy and punctual, and happy to answer any questions.Customer service was excellent, they sorted out all the paperwork with Energex, any issues I had and did a follow up.

Lots of options available but few with this level of customer service. Professional, reliable, helpful and pleasant to work with ~ made the process easy from start to finish. Every person knew their stuff and were more than happy to answer all my questions from first contact through installation and beyond. Highly recommend this company.
Very professional, efficient and competent team from sales through to install crew.

They were very quick with the Quote I was happy with, the install was fantastic punctual, Tidy and Polite.Very happy with the supply and install all happened within a day and all working, had to wait a couple of weeks for AGL to install a new meter, all up running now.
We are happy with the sales/quoting process.The installation went well, and the installers were knowledgable and adaptable.The installers organised the grid connection.

An all round stress free and excellent experience. Richard and the team did a first rate job and took care of everything. I didn’t have to do a thing. Courteous, friendly and professional, these guys deserve the thumbs up from me. Thanks for a great job. Well done.
Awesome customer service and a great quality installation.Thanks Circuit Alert!

From first contact they listened to what i thought i would need then explained what i actually needed. The whole process was was explained and executed with ease. The installers did a excellent job they were quick and tidy. My wife felt comfortable in the house while they were here.
Effortless from start to finish. Informative, great customer service. Neat, tidy and efficient installation, great handover. Couldn’t ask for anything more. Highly recommended!
Very polite and punctual for install. Cleaned up after themselves.. Great customers service with questions afterwards. Helped with grid connection. Would definitely recommend!
We found dealing with the team at Circuit Alert made the whole process go smoothly from the start to finish. Well done Circuit Alert.Ian and Barbara

Patient and understanding during the enquiry process no question was a problem for them to give us their time to fully explain.Installation went very smoothly and they have had to return a couple of times as we are experiencing a slight problem connecting to the SolaX app. This is ongoing at the moment but it isn't compromising the working of the solar system itself, just waiting for some sunshine though to give us a good boost.
The install was done professionally in one day, every thing was left neat & tidy.Had to wait over 3 weeks to have the new meter installed by the energy company.All working now.
From the very start and all the way through customer service was outstanding. Clear communication with delays due to weather. Site was cleaned and could hardly tell they had been. Highly recommend

Forget all the hype. These guys installed a good system at a great price. They spent a lot of time on the phone with me explaining how it all works. They gave good advice on selecting the right size system for us. Very happy.

Trying to find a local company who will actually turn up for a quote nearly made me give up on the search for solar, then I contacted Circuit Alert.      They have restored my faith in tradies.From the initial ph call, Lisa and the team provided exactly what they said they would.The installers texted to say they'd be there in 30 mins AND they were.The panels and inverter were installed proficiently and without a trace of rubbish left behind. Thanks guys.Everything was explained in easy to understand terms and I was told, any questions, just ring us.I'm very happy with the job from start to finish, can't wait to start saving on my electricity bills.I would highly recommend Circuit Alert for anyone looking to deal with a reputable solar company.

Lisa and the whole Circuite Alert team were fantastic to work with. They took into account our unique needs and budget and came up with a package that ticked all the boxes. The panels also look really neat and tidy on our roof. Looking forward to all our electricity savings now this is up and running.
Lisa, Lachlan and the team were brilliant with the specs and installation of our solar system. I would definately recommend them.

Circuit Alert Electrical & Solar from initial consult through the process to installation was absolutely immaculate! Chris was wonderful and was a big part of why we went with Circuit Alert.  His friendliness, knowledge, and speed of feedback was next level.  Will refer them far and wide.

Excellent service. Prompt to visit the site. Offering logical, doable and affordable solutions. Great communication with the office. Very professional job done on the day. Particularly liked the attention to the visual aspect to our installation and care about the overall look of the panels and wiring.
Very helpful and friendly staff. The whole process was carried out without a hitch. I would highly recommend this company.

Organising solar panels for my home with Circuit Alert was the easiest and most pleasant experience. Their team are very professional but still have that small town touch of personality and warmth that made the entire process so much more comfortable. Lisa is a fantastic coordinator that is so easily accessible and endlessly helpful. Not to mention their product is also rated No.1 solar panels according to choice independent reviewers.Could not more highly recommend!
Brent and Glenn did an excellent job to finish a difficult installation within one day. I cannot speak highly enough of my dealings with Circuit Alert. I highly recommend them.

Phil went with us Trough the design, type, quality and adapted his suggestion with our expectations. The job has been done neatly and they took their time to make sure everything is synchronised with each other. They worked 3 days in comparison to a neighbour’s house that had contractors coming from Newcastle to Central Coast installing a similar size system (14.8kW) in 6 hours. We will see how long that system will last. I am quite confident with our selection which is top of the range 38 x QCell 390W with optimisers and 2 x 5Kw SolarEdge inverters. Unfortunately we are single phased and could not go bigger. We are waiting for the time to get batteries

It is rare that for me to post reviews, but in this instance, I feel I must. The experience I have had, from start to finish, with Circuit Alert, has been completely outstanding and well surpassed any expectations I previously held regarding the mediocrity and customer focussed service that can be lacking in our world. Circuit Alert has been a complete breath of fresh air, restoring my faith in always putting their customer first. Moreover, the expertise of the team is exemplary! I always felt in complete control over what product I should choose. The advice and guidance were clearly based on outstanding industry knowledge. The system I had installed is perfect for us and we are thrilled with the results we are achieving – why didn’t we do this years ago? The installation team was brilliant! Reliable, punctual, courteous, and completely professional. Perhaps the overriding factor for me is Circuit Alert’s proven commitment to looking after their customers post-sale and installation. This is quite remarkable. The care I continue to receive from Circuit Alert, even though my solar system is perfect, is outstanding. Just the little emails I receive to ask if I need help with navigating the solar tariff landscape and providers or just checking in to see how the benefits are working for us. Circuit Alert has completely restored my faith in traditional customer focussed outcomes with a deep sincere passion for us, the client, coming first. I cannot thank them enough!

Circuit Alert have been fantastic they are very friendly and well organised! We have had a great experience from first consultation with Chris to meeting Martin at the garden show to discuss our system to Lisa contacting us to walk us through the install to Richard and the team that came to install. I am delighted with our system installed we have been setup with the correct size system for our needs. I'm happy we chose Circuit Electrical to be our installers its great to have a local company with their ongoing support.

Great experience from start to finish. Salesperson explained the options well. Didn't pressure us. Installers arrived as scheduled and were clearly well-experienced in doing what they were doing. Very neat installation. And they were courteous and helpful in explaining the system. The grid connection went smoothly too.

We were very happy with our solar installation done by Circuit Alert Electrical and Solar. From start to finish the communication was clear and everything went smoothly. Installation was punctual and professional. Afterwards they organised everything with the energy retailer advising them that solar had been installed. Fully recommended.

Good afternoon,We had quotes from 3 different suppliers, but chose Circuit Alert as the much better option and price wise much better.Sales person came out talked us through what would be the better option for our requirements, quotation was sent, we accepted. Customer service called to make and appointment for the installation and on the day of installation 3 gentlemen arrived on time, explained what they would be doing installing 26 x 390 watt panels. They gents were swift left absolutely no mess and were all extremely polite and courteous. Installation was done in 1 day and all went well.Customer service organise for us to connection to the Grid through their connections, so absolutely no bother for us what so ever.Fro the day of accepting the quotation we were kept informed all the day until completion as well as various follow up calls after the completion to ensure we were happy.Their professionalism and customer service is beyond excellent.Extremely happy clients here and could not recommend the enough for the brilliant service.Happy to elaborate further if required.Best regardsFrank

Martin, Richard, Lisa and the crew were absolutely exception in the entire process, price, customer service and going beyond what I expected. I had quote a number of solar business quote. All in the area are fantastic - however Circuit Alert stood out.  The team were super friendly with a "anything is possible" attitude and they were willing to go all the way to help with my complex install. Nothing was too hard.  Their follow service was also fantastic.  I would highly recommend Circuit Alert!
Outstanding customer service from Lisa and the team. Competitive quote and regular updates continue on how the system is performing. Will be using them again for our next home.

The entire experience with Circuit Alert felt very personal and was competitive. From initial phone contact to survey and quotation, followed by final installation the team at Circuit Alert were attentive, responsive and focused on giving us the system upgrade we wanted. The system is up and running creating income for us rather than a long term drain on our retirement funds!

I wanted solar on our roof but was unsure of what company to use….Before deciding on Circuit Alert Electrical And Solar I did a lot of research so I could understand how solar would minimise our electricity accountI found I was continually being bombarded with tv ads and phone calls and nobody was able to answer any of my detailed questions... So after six months of research I decided to call a number of local businessesMy second  call was to Circuit Alert Electrical And Solar from Nambour..I spoke to a lady called Lisa Rudd she was very helpful in every area... size of solar units... the advantage of putting a bigger unit on your roof, the prices, the rebates for finance and the warranties.All my questions were answered to my approval and the price was very affordable.I agreed to use this company...  The boys came out and organised to put the solar on the roof... all done in one day and in a very professional manner.They explained to me how it all worked including the apps... The daily solar electricity that we created  and how that information would be  emailed to me daily so I could track the solar we had made during the day…We have now had  solar three months…. working beautifully,We received our first account from Origin and was more than pleased with our bill...We paid our normal electricity account and received a credit of $206.... not bad for our first account we thought!So if you’re looking to put solar on your roof... I have no hesitation in referring Circuit Alert Electrical And Solar they are great to work with and talk you all the way through to make sure it all goes smoothly...And they are local people...Support Your Local Business which is very important to our way of thinking…..

Installed 10/2/21I found Circuit Alter via a reference from Solarquotes.com.au. Impressively, Lachlan was available to come see  me the same day and we sat for about an hour or more looking through the various location of where the panels would be best suited and what size of system would be right for me too ( this is very personal , so I appreciated the expert tips he provided)In terms of a quote, it was very competitive ( not Arise Solar lows & its associated authenticity problems) for a reputable company and the details were easy to followIn terms of installation, I chose to work with their sub-contractors ( Lee and Justin) - (I'm told these guys used to work for Circuit Alert and now run their own business ) - They were absolutely phenomenal - we encountered some building structural queries and Lee was able to real world assess other options for the panel locations - this made a world of differenceThe quality of the finished job was met to my high standards and the installers were super professional and friendlyThe admin team at Circuit Alert ( Lisa) was so helpful that she was even able to provide some unbiased advise on a sizing option that I had !Overall - Highly recommend Circuit Alert but also encourage you to make your own decision :)
We are very happy with the service provided, when we had a query they came out& had an inspection & explained what our query was, no problems.

Couldn't have been easier. Came out to assess site, fair pricing with reputable brands. Installers were great, minimum fuss and easy to talk to. Lisa was great with the follow up service. Felt taken care of by a local company that gives a damn. Pulling 40+kwh on sunny days and haven't had a bill since. Enough said.

perfect choice for my 6.6kw system installed today. The team were on time, polite, friendly, efficient, organised and acted professional throughout process. Lisa at Circuit Alert handled my booking and all admin details with energex etc. Effort free. Lisa also very polite and professional.The system installed beautifully. SMA Sunnyboy inverter & 18x 370w monoPerc split cell PA panels, all stainless fittings, for nice price of $4750 after STC rebate.Well worth entrusting Circuit Alert from Nambour for my job in Gympie. Thanks you guys.

We were cautious about who to ask to give us a quote for Solar. My parents recommended Circuit Alert and we are so pleased we called. From the moment we made contact you were prompt, friendly and gave us clear and factual information. You made us feel that we were in good hands. The installation went well even if the boys were surprised when they rocked up to find we were a high set house not a low set house.We appreciated being given advice about our internal switchboard which we had been concerned about for some time. You we able to organise someone to come back to upgrade this as well. Your workers were efficient, friendly and accommodating of us being around the house as they worked. I would recommend your company to any friend who asked. Thank you for making this process so effortless.

Even though it was a particularly busy time of the year with people signing up before year end and a reduction in the government rebates, Circuit Alert were punctual and completed the installation as per the schedule. There sales person pointed out a few installation issues that were missed by another installer. The selection of equipment was good and  the installation process went well though they did make a mistake with the meter box but realised it themselves and came back quickly to complete the job with no impact to myself.
No nonsense quotes, relaxed sales style not pushy. Friendly informative staff, efficient. Wouldn't hesitate recommending them to any interested parties.
The whole process was very smooth, followed up and arrived when they said. Very informative in making sure all questions were asked regarding system. Would recommend and use again.
These guys were great from start to finish. Great customer service. Can't fault them at all
Surprisingly easy, no questions were left unanswered. Installation was very professional and afterwards we wondered why we hadn't gone solar earlier.

Quick and efficient install. Very impressed with how tidy the electrical install is, straight lines done by somebody who takes pride in his workmanship. Has their own employed installers and a family run business that has been around for years.

From the first visit by Lachlan one of their sales team to the commissioning of the system by Richard and his team it couldn't of been smoother. Lachlan took time to explain everything about the system and what would be the best size for me to go with. The installers we're very neat and took time to show me the Wifi, app, everyone in the office was great to and helped me choose the best retailer to go with.This is one Family run Busness I would be very happy to recommend.
